name: RTP-LX
description: RTP-LX is a human-transcreated and human-annotated multilingual corpus of toxic prompts and outputs in 28 languages, designed to evaluate the ability of language models to detect culturally-specific toxic language and subtle harmful content in multilingual scenarios.
reputation: A recent research benchmark from the paper introducing RTP-LX; it is not yet widely established as a standard community benchmark.
notes: Includes culturally-specific toxic language detection; highlights challenges in holistic toxicity scoring and subtle harm detection.
